1. Executive Summary & Diagnostic Assessment

The composite Civic Intelligence Score for Koraput currently stands at 58.4 / 100. While basic all-weather road connectivity under PMGSY has expanded to 74.6% of habitations, critical bottlenecks persist in Secondary Healthcare Access (52.1 pts), particularly emergency transit across Bandhugaon and Narayanpatna blocks. Furthermore, over 85% of GI-tagged Koraput Arabica Coffee and spices are exported without primary processing, causing substantial value-loss.
